flashcard_questions.q: What proportion of people who caught smallpox died from it?
Who introduced inoculation to Britain after seeing it used in Turkey?
What did inoculation involve putting into a healthy person?
flashcard_questions.a: Pus from a real smallpox sore

flashcard_questions.q: Which famous surgeon taught Jenner to test his ideas by experiment?
Which mild disease did Jenner notice protected milkmaids from smallpox?
Which milkmaid provided the cowpox pus Jenner used in 1796?
Which boy did Jenner vaccinate with cowpox in 1796?
How many further tests did Jenner carry out before he published?
What year did Jenner publish his findings on vaccination?
Which Latin word for cow gave vaccination its name?
What year did the British government make smallpox vaccination compulsory for children?
Who drew the 1802 cartoon showing vaccinated people sprouting cow-like features?
How many members did the Anti-Vaccination League have at its peak?
Which ruler ordered the whole French army to be vaccinated in 1805?
What total sum did Parliament award Jenner to continue his research?

notes: 15 cards: 6 person to role, 4 statistic, 3 event to date, 2 term to definition. Split the opposition section into single named facts (Gillray, the League's membership) rather than a card listing the reasons people objected.
